title: Tailscale DERP Relay Usage Spike
app: OpenWrt, UniFi, Pi-hole, AdGuard Home, Tailscale, Cloudflare Tunnel, DNS over HTTPS resolvers, and scheduled probes via syslog, APIs, and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=tailscale:netmap
| bin _time span=1d
| stats count(eval(path_type="derp")) as derp_sessions, count as total_sessions by node _time
| eval derp_pct=round(100*derp_sessions/total_sessions,1)
| where total_sessions>0 AND derp_pct>20
| sort - derp_pct
description: Uses Tailscale netmap exports telemetry to monitor the share of sessions falling back to DERP relays in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for direct-path problems that add latency to the mesh, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Tailscale netmap exports data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a hourly cadence.
grandmaExplanation: It records the share of sessions falling back to DERP relays so you can spot direct-path problems that add latency to the mesh before it becomes annoying.
